title: マルゼンスキーの大切なもの

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I want you to come somewhere with me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I want you to come somewhere with me.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Are you free tonight?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky brings me to the beach late at night. There appears to be a haunted trail event happening.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: One of the younger students told me about this! ♪ It's booming with all the hip young'uns!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The rules are simple—reach the goal at the shoreline. The better you place, the better your prize.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: First place gets a chance to turn anything they want into a figurine?! Does that mean I could make one of Tata?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Omigosh! I absolutely must have one on my dashboard!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, the haunted trail begins!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Eek!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yikes, that spooked me… Hey, this is just konjac jelly! Geez Louise!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Haha, you get a bit of a scare, but this is good fun! Come on, there's still more to go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Usually she plays the role of everyone's trusty big sister, so it's a little rare to see her acting more her age. We press on, sticking close to each other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rustle

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Eek?!
Gyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A teary-eyed Sweep Tosho jumps out from a stack of driftwood.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wh-wha… Maruzen?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Sweep Pea! Oh dear, are you all right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her playful demeanor all about disappears as she quickly snaps back into big sister mode.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I-I'm fine, okay?! Me and Rob Roy accidentally split up, that's all…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I may be fine all by myself, but Rob Roy's a big baby, so she's probably off crying somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho's eyes gradually well with tears.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: …Trainer. Can we try winning some other time?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: …Trainer. Can we try winning some other time?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Thanks a bunch! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Don't you worry, Sweep Pea. Let's find Robby Roy together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky walks with her hand-in-hand, matching her pace. That's the reliable Maruzensky everyone knows.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It's a straight path all the way to the finish line, and we haven't seen her yet, so she's totes up ahead.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hm, but it's quite dark around these parts, and the path's a little wide. There's a chance we just haven't noticed her.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Where could she be? Trainer, what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Where could she be? Trainer, what do you think?
choice_data_list: Let's go to the finish line.
Let's head back to the start line.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Right, we should first try reaching the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We walk for a while until eventually we reach a clearing that resembles a finish line.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hm… Is Robby Roy somewhere around here?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh! There you are, Sweep! …Maruzen! You're here too?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh?! So, Robby Roy was here with you this whole time!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: That's right. We just happened to cross paths. At any rate, I'm glad you found Sweep safe and sound.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What gives, Rob Roy? Why'd you run away like that?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Sorry! I-I thought that you were right behind me!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Now now, aren't you glad you're back together now? Let bygones be bygones!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: …Hmph, whatever! It's not like I'm upset or anything. Just… don't worry me again.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Sweep. You too, Maruzen.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's right. You can have this if you'd like…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Zenno Rob Roy offers up the winning prize for the haunted trail contest.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Um… I ended up winning because I was so focused on running.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Thank you for finding Sweep for me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky beams at the sight of Zenno Rob Roy timidly passing her the coupon.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: …I appreciate the offer, but why not claim your prize and use it with Sweep Pea?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'd appreciate it a lot more if you two would let me know what amazing figurine you end up making! ♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Maruzen…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: For instance… you could make a character from a storybook, Robby Roy!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: And Sweep Pea, I think you would love making your favorite familiar or wand.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: But… well, um, sorry… and th-thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, I spot Maruzensky warmly watching over Sweep Tosho and Zenno Rob Roy as they chat about figurine ideas.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Okey-dokey! Let's go back where we started!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We walk for a while, until eventually we find ourselves back at the starting line. There we see…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's Sweep! Tickezo, I found Sweep!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ooohhh! I'm shoo glad! We were shoo shoo wurrieed!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: H-huh? What are you two doing here?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Well, we met up with Rob Roy at the finish line, and she told us what happened!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Scarlet said she'd watch Rob Roy, so we came looking for you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So that's the sitch! Good thing she's with Scarlet! What a relief!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rumble…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Th-that wasn't me! I'm not the slightest bit hungry…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe, now that my nerves are out of the way, I'm starting to get hungry too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh! I think I saw a milkshake stand down at the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: How lovely. ♪ Now that things have calmed down, let's all go grab some shakes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We regroup at the finish line and make our way to the milkshake stand. However…

text_block_list.name: Store Clerk A (Man)
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, but I only have enough to make six more. I'm afraid someone will have to miss out…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh! That's fine, we'll take the six! I don't need to have one.
choice_data_list: Would you like half of mine?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe, sure thing. Thanks, Trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe, sure thing. Thanks, Trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Afterward, we sip and savor the milkshakes under a starry sky and listen to the sound of the waves.
